items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Ralph later drummed with the Wolverines.

ctx.x: Ralph later drummed with the Wolverines. And Frank was the first drummer with that band. And Jack Pettis, you see. And then, I'm missing one. I think the original.
Well, a Chicago piano player. Well, yes. Or Schoble.
